description: Lossless accounting of every meaningful product signal from every EOS source document. Each entry traces a signal from its origin through to its preservation in the 14.6B canonical artifact set.
provenance_detail: Signals extracted from: Google Doc (via Phase 14.3A claims), Phase 14.4 desired state canon, Phase 14.5 convergence plan, Phase 14.5A 13-layer stack, Phase 14.6B corrective artifacts, operator corrections in mission brief, and code-resolved truth from GitHub main and Beast feature/company-system.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Portfolio and Multi-Company Management module allows operators to manage multiple businesses from one platform with cross-company metrics
signals.rationale: Core to corrected hierarchy (Operator -> Portfolio -> Entities). Operator correction elevated this from feature to foundational architecture.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Org Chart Engine generates organizational structures based on business model and stage
signals.rationale: Org chart generation is part of the 25-step onboarding flow (steps 9-11) and ongoing entity management.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Role System with first-class role objects supporting human and AI ownership
signals.rationale: Roles are the authority boundary layer. Preserved in communication/delegation architecture with permission tiers (READ/DRAFT/EXECUTE/COMMIT).

signals.summarized_source_claim: Universal Dashboard Architecture with Header, AI Control Panel, Left Rail, Workspace, Right Rail
signals.rationale: Shell layout is canonical. Preserved with operator corrections (executive command center aesthetic, finance-grade clarity).

signals.summarized_source_claim: Workflow and SOP Engine with approval gates, retries, checkpoints, and branching
signals.rationale: Workflow engine is core operational infrastructure. Onboarding generates initial workflows (step 12). End-state includes full branching, retry, and approval gate support.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Skill System with reusable skills, versioning, and trust scoring
signals.rationale: Skill system exists in UMH projection code (DepartmentAgent._add_skill). Trust scoring and versioning are end-state features not yet implemented.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Agent Runtime with planner, skill router, and tool executor per role
signals.rationale: Agent runtime architecture preserved in communication/delegation architecture. 10 department agents implemented in UMH projection, 6 more defined as professional gaps.

signals.summarized_source_claim: AI Compute and Model Routing with centralized gateway and cost-aware selection
signals.rationale: Intelligence routing is a UMH substrate capability. EOS inherits it via UMH projection mapping. Preserved in business democratization doctrine UMH mappings.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Memory and Knowledge Architecture with working, session, and long-term memory plus knowledge graph
signals.rationale: Memory architecture is a UMH substrate capability. Onboarding seeds initial memory (step 25 output). Full knowledge graph is end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Knowledge Graph for semantic retrieval and relationship reasoning
signals.rationale: Knowledge graph is UMH substrate capability (Business Ontology projection). End-state feature, not MVP.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Human Intelligence Layer with profiles for contacts
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP in desired_state_canon.mvp_definition.explicit_exclusions. Preserved as end-state concept.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Reality Intelligence Engine for external market and competitor intelligence pipeline
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP as 'Advanced market intelligence'. End-state feature.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Governance and Permissions with hybrid RBAC+ABAC and autonomy levels
signals.rationale: Governance is foundational. Permission tiers (READ/DRAFT/EXECUTE/COMMIT) are implemented in UMH projection. Full RBAC+ABAC is end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Resilience and Failure Architecture with retries, circuit breakers, saga compensation, failover
signals.rationale: Resilience patterns are infrastructure-level. Basic retry exists in UMH substrate. Full saga compensation and circuit breakers are end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Cross-Platform Integration with CreatorOS and LyfeOS through shared intelligence substrate
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP. Cross-platform integration is a post-MVP capability when all three Trinity products are operational.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Founder Command Center with KPIs and next-best actions
signals.rationale: Dashboard is the operator's primary command surface. Onboarding generates initial KPI dashboard (step 16). UI canon defines finance-grade visualization standards.

signals.summarized_source_claim: UBOS Template Engine providing franchise-like business templates
signals.rationale: Template library is end-state. Onboarding entity-type-aware generation is the MVP equivalent of templates.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Universal Business Primitives across 16 categories
signals.rationale: Business primitives are the type system for EOS. Preserved in portfolio/entity ontology with 13 entity-level definitions and 19 business types.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Self-Improvement Loop with pattern detection and workflow refinement
signals.rationale: Self-improvement is a UMH substrate capability (feedback loop projection). End-state feature.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Auth/Entry screen for sign in, create or access workspace
signals.rationale: Auth is step 1 of onboarding. Beast branch already has Clerk auth implemented.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Company Setup screen to define company name, type, stage, offer, target customer, core goals
signals.rationale: Expanded from single company setup to 25-step onboarding flow covering portfolio, entity, stage, goals, complexity, and generation. Operator correction broadened scope.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Home Dashboard with company summary, KPI strip, today panel, AI copilot panel, operating memory/notes
signals.rationale: Dashboard is the primary command surface. Finance-grade design direction specified in UI canon. KPI visualization standards defined.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Company Settings/Profile screen for company configuration and profile management
signals.rationale: Settings is standard product infrastructure. Preserved in product canon.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Department/Role Management screen to create departments, roles, responsibilities with linked workflows/tasks/docs
signals.rationale: Department/role management is a gap in both codebases per convergence plan (EOS-PROD-001). Onboarding generates initial structure; this screen manages it ongoing.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Workflow Library to browse, create, and manage workflows/SOPs
signals.rationale: Workflow library is part of MVP release R3. Onboarding generates initial workflows; library manages them ongoing.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Workflow Run View to execute workflows step-by-step with AI assistance, mark complete, store notes/results
signals.rationale: Workflow run view is a gap per convergence plan (EOS-PROD-002). Part of MVP release R3.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Task Board/List to create, assign, link to workflows, update status, priority, due dates
signals.rationale: Task management is MVP release R2. Onboarding generates initial recurring tasks (step 14).

signals.summarized_source_claim: AI Copilot Workspace for business questions, summaries, workflow/SOP/plan drafting, next-best action suggestions
signals.rationale: AI copilot is MVP release R4. Corrected to route through EA agent per operator communication architecture correction.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Docs/Notes Workspace for SOP notes, role notes, operating notes, strategy notes
signals.rationale: Documents workspace is MVP release R5. SOPs generated during onboarding live here.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Settings screen for user and workspace configuration
signals.rationale: Settings is standard product infrastructure. Includes approval configuration (onboarding step 22).

signals.summarized_source_claim: Set up business operating system workflow: create workspace, define company, get AI-generated org structure
signals.rationale: This is the onboarding flow itself. Expanded from implicit to explicit 25-step specification.

signals.summarized_source_claim: See what matters today workflow: home dashboard, KPIs, alerts, next-best actions, active workflows
signals.rationale: This is the daily operating cadence. Dashboard is the primary surface. EA agent delivers morning briefings.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Define org structure workflow: departments, roles, responsibilities
signals.rationale: Org structure definition is onboarding steps 9-11 (generate org chart, departments, roles). Also available post-onboarding.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Store and run workflows/SOPs: create or AI-generate, step through with AI
signals.rationale: Workflow creation and execution is MVP release R3. Onboarding generates initial workflows and SOPs (steps 12-13).

signals.summarized_source_claim: Use AI to plan and draft work: plans, documents, role definitions, workflow drafts, summaries
signals.rationale: AI drafting is core EA and department agent capability. Preserved in communication/delegation architecture.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Track tasks and priorities: create/assign tasks, link to workflows, status dashboard
signals.rationale: Task management is MVP release R2. Tasks generated during onboarding (step 14) and managed through task board screen.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Keep business context persistent: memory stores company context, workflow context, preferences
signals.rationale: Persistent context is MVP release R5. Onboarding seeds initial memory. Agent memory maintains context over time.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Review key metrics and next-best actions: KPI cards, AI recommendations, portfolio views
signals.rationale: KPI review is the daily operating workflow. Dashboard generated during onboarding (step 16). Finance-grade visualization standards in UI canon.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Portfolio multi-company management with cross-company metrics
signals.rationale: Foundational feature. Portfolio is the top-level entity in the corrected hierarchy. 8 entity types, 19 business types defined.

signals.summarized_source_claim: AI-generated org charts based on business model and stage
signals.rationale: Onboarding step 9 generates org charts. Generation is entity-type and stage-aware.

signals.summarized_source_claim: First-class role objects with human/AI ownership
signals.rationale: Roles with human/AI/unfilled status generated during onboarding (step 11). Permission tiers enforced at agent level.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Universal dashboard with Header, AI Control Panel, Left Rail, Workspace, Right Rail
signals.rationale: Shell layout is canonical with 7 components defined. Layout architecture specifies dimensions and behaviors.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Workflow engine with approval gates, retries, checkpoints, branching
signals.rationale: Basic workflow creation/execution is MVP. Full approval gates, retries, checkpoints, branching is end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Reusable skill system with versioning and trust scoring
signals.rationale: Skills exist in UMH projection (62 skills across 10 agents). Versioning and trust scoring are end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Role-specific agent runtime with planner, skill router, tool executor
signals.rationale: Agent runtime is core architecture. 10 agents implemented, 6 more defined. Routing chain is EA -> CEO -> Department.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Centralized AI Gateway with model routing and cost-aware selection
signals.rationale: UMH substrate provides this. EOS inherits via projection mapping (Business Intelligence Routing).

signals.summarized_source_claim: Working/session/long-term memory with knowledge graph
signals.rationale: Full three-tier memory is end-state. Onboarding seeds initial knowledge base. UMH provides the memory infrastructure.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Semantic retrieval and relationship reasoning
signals.rationale: Semantic retrieval is end-state UMH capability. Embedding dimension mismatch (384 vs 1536) is an open question.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Human intelligence profiles for contacts
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP. End-state feature for relationship management.

signals.summarized_source_claim: External market/competitor intelligence pipeline
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP as 'Advanced market intelligence'. Research agent defined as INFERRED_PROFESSIONAL_GAP.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Hybrid RBAC+ABAC governance with autonomy levels
signals.rationale: Basic permission tiers implemented. Full RBAC+ABAC with autonomy levels is end-state. Approval configuration in onboarding step 22.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Resilience: retries, circuit breakers, saga compensation, failover
signals.rationale: Infrastructure resilience patterns. End-state feature. Basic retry via UMH substrate.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Cross-platform integration with CreatorOS and LyfeOS
signals.rationale: Explicitly excluded from MVP. Post-MVP when all Trinity products are operational.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Strategic command center with KPIs and next-best actions
signals.rationale: Command center is the dashboard. Onboarding generates KPIs (step 16). Finance-grade visualization standards defined.

signals.summarized_source_claim: UBOS template library with franchise-like business templates
signals.rationale: Template library is end-state. Onboarding entity-type-aware generation is the functional equivalent for MVP.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 16 universal business primitive categories
signals.rationale: Business primitives preserved and expanded in ontology. 13 hierarchy-level definitions, 8 entity types, 19 business types.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Self-improvement loop with pattern detection and workflow refinement
signals.rationale: Self-improvement is UMH substrate capability (Business Feedback Loop). End-state feature.

signals.summarized_source_claim: No specific auth provider comparison finalized (Clerk selected but end-state SSO/magic-link undefined)
signals.rationale: Clerk is selected for MVP. End-state SSO/magic-link strategy unresolved.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Pricing tiers not defined - no mention of free vs paid plans
signals.rationale: Pricing is an operator decision. Not technical but critical for product positioning.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Embedding dimension mismatch (384 vs 1536) unresolved
signals.rationale: Technical decision that affects knowledge graph and semantic retrieval architecture.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Whether UBOS template library will be community-contributed or curated only
signals.rationale: Business decision about template marketplace economics.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Local/private AI runtime scope undefined beyond aspiration
signals.rationale: Local AI is explicitly excluded from MVP. End-state feature.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Multi-region deployment strategy not decided
signals.rationale: Single-region deployment for MVP. Multi-region is end-state.

signals.summarized_source_claim: How to bridge Python substrate and TypeScript SaaS frontend
signals.rationale: Critical architecture decision. UMH is Python, EOS SaaS is TypeScript. Bridge mechanism undefined.

signals.summarized_source_claim: No competitive analysis included (vs Monday.com, Notion AI, ClickUp Brain)
signals.rationale: Competitive analysis is a strategic input that could influence product direction.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Skill marketplace economics undefined
signals.rationale: Skill marketplace is explicitly excluded from MVP.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Mobile app strategy not specified (web-responsive vs native)
signals.rationale: Mobile strategy is a product decision. Web-responsive is the default assumption per OS Platform Standard.

signals.summarized_source_claim: End-State PRD appears twice in Tab 1 with slight variations
signals.rationale: Duplicate PRD sections in original Google Doc. Resolved by Phase 14.4 desired state canon which consolidates.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Substrate audit appears 3 times in Tab 15
signals.rationale: Duplicate audit sections in original Google Doc. Resolved by canonicalization in Phase 14.4+.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Reality Mimicry content duplicated in Tab 12
signals.rationale: Duplicate content in original Google Doc. Resolved by canonicalization.

signals.summarized_source_claim: North star referenced as $100K in one section, $10K/month in current reality
signals.rationale: $10K/month is the current north star per operator global context. $100K is a future milestone. Not a contradiction but different time horizons.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EOSGateway class name in docs, renamed to Gateway in code
signals.rationale: Resolved by projection boundary law. Gateway is the canonical name. EOSGateway is historical.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EOSContext in docs, renamed to SubstrateContext in code
signals.rationale: Resolved by projection boundary law. SubstrateContext is canonical. EOSContext is historical.

signals.summarized_source_claim: eos_ai/ module paths in docs, reorganized to substrate/+adapters/+transports/ in code
signals.rationale: Resolved by UMH convergence (2026-05-23). eos_ai/ is historical. Code now uses 4-layer architecture.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EOS democratizes the ability to structure, operate, optimize, and scale economic activity. Not just founder tooling.
signals.rationale: Foundational operator correction. Changes center of gravity from founder-only to universal economic activity democratization.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EOS is a product of OST, not Lyfe Institute. Lyfe Institute is a company managed inside EOS.
signals.rationale: Critical ownership correction. Changes product attribution from Lyfe Institute to OST.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Correct hierarchy: Operator/User -> Portfolio(s) -> Entities -> Business/Investment/Asset Operations -> Teams/Agents/Roles/Permissions -> Workflows/SOPs/Tasks/Tools -> Capital/Transactions/KPIs/Reports -> Outcomes/Proof/Optimization
signals.rationale: Foundational hierarchy correction. 8-level chain replaces implicit company-first model. Portfolio is top-level, entities are execution vehicles.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Communication chain: User/Founder -> EA Agent -> Portfolio Advisor OR CEO Agent -> Department/Specialist Agents. EA does NOT route directly to department agents.
signals.rationale: Critical operator correction. Establishes EA as primary intake, prohibits EA-to-department direct routing.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Entities include businesses, investments, startups, real estate, stocks, asset holdings, agencies, SaaS companies, media companies, operating companies
signals.rationale: Broadens entity model from businesses-only to all economic vehicles. 8 entity types and 19 business types defined.

signals.summarized_source_claim: UI aesthetic is executive command center, business cockpit, finance-grade clarity, strategic control. NOT playful, NOT creator-social, NOT RPG.
signals.rationale: Critical aesthetic correction. Separates EOS from LyfeOS (RPG) and CreatorOS (social) aesthetics.

signals.summarized_source_claim: UI Shell: Left Rail (role-dependent navigation, portfolio/company/entity switcher), Main Workspace, Right Rail AI Assistant, Floating AI Control Panel, Risk/Approval Notices, Activity/Event Feed, Chat/EA command box
signals.rationale: 7-component shell specification from operator. Preserved in UI canon with dimensions, behaviors, and Beast code file references.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Four onboarding paths: Start New Business, Model Existing Business, Create Investment/Entity, Import Existing Operation
signals.rationale: Operator specified four distinct paths replacing prior assumption of single business creation flow.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Primary metaphor is Executive Command Center / Business Cockpit. Reference products: Bloomberg, Carta, AngelList, Mercury, Stripe, Linear.
signals.rationale: Canonical aesthetic identity with reference products for design direction.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 7 anti-patterns: playful/gamified, creator-social, RPG/personal-development, glassmorphic, neon/cyberpunk, casual/rounded, marketing-site aesthetic
signals.rationale: Explicit anti-patterns prevent aesthetic drift. Each anti-pattern maps to a sibling product or common design mistake.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Dark mode primary, finance-grade palette. Cool blue accent for trust/authority. Green for gain, red for loss, amber for warning.
signals.rationale: Color direction specified. Dark mode as default mirrors Bloomberg/trading terminal convention.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Inter or equivalent sans-serif. Monospace for financial figures. Tabular numerals required for aligned columns.
signals.rationale: Typography direction for finance-grade readability. Monospace financial figures prevent misalignment.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Compact density by default. 8px base grid. 36-40px table rows. 12-16px card padding. NOT generous SaaS whitespace.
signals.rationale: Compact density maximizes information per viewport. Finance-grade interfaces prioritize data density.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Sharp borders (4-6px radius), visible 1px borders, minimal animations (150ms fade), Lucide line icons, no gradient buttons
signals.rationale: Component style direction for precise, functional UI. Sharp borders over rounded, flat panels over shadows.

signals.summarized_source_claim: KPI hero metric cards with trend indicators and sparklines. Dense sortable tables with financial formatting. Recharts or Tremor for charts.
signals.rationale: Data visualization standards for finance-grade dashboards. Right-aligned numbers, tabular numerals, negative values in red.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Command palette (Cmd+K), keyboard shortcuts, power-user-first design
signals.rationale: Power user features. INFERRED_PROFESSIONAL_GAP. Not implemented in either codebase but critical for daily operators.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 10 shared OS platform standards: shadcn/ui, Tailwind, responsive design, WCAG 2.1 AA, design tokens, interaction standards, three-panel shell, TanStack Query, wouter/React Router, strict TypeScript
signals.rationale: Shared standards across all Trinity products. These are the structural skeleton that EOS inherits.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 7 shell components: Left Rail (240-280px), Main Workspace (flexible), Right Rail (320-400px), Header (48-56px), Floating AI Control Panel (FAB), Risk/Approval Notices (inline/banner), Activity/Event Feed (tab in right rail)
signals.rationale: Shell layout with pixel-level specifications. Beast code files referenced for each component.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 10 onboarding design principles including: onboarding IS the product demo, generate dont interrogate, progressive disclosure, every step produces visible output, reversible, path-dependent intelligence, solo operator default
signals.rationale: Design principles govern the entire onboarding experience. Core to product quality.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Steps 1-7: Account creation (Clerk), Create portfolio, Choose path (4 paths), Select entity type, Choose stage (8 stages), Define goals/constraints, Define complexity (5 levels)
signals.rationale: Configuration steps that collect all inputs needed for AI generation. Each step narrows and refines subsequent steps.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Steps 8-19: Generate workspace, org chart, departments, roles, workflows, SOPs, tasks, tool stack, KPIs/dashboard, client lifecycle, offer model, investment/asset tracking model
signals.rationale: 12 AI-generation steps that produce a complete operating system. Entity-type-aware, stage-aware, complexity-aware generation.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Steps 20-25: Configure team/solo mode, Configure agents (EA/Portfolio Advisor/CEO), Configure approval settings, Configure integrations, Review everything, Approve and enter active mode
signals.rationale: Configuration and activation steps. Operator configures governance, reviews all generated artifacts, then activates.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 15 onboarding outputs: portfolio, entity, org chart, roles, workflows/SOPs/tasks, tools, dashboard/KPIs, agents, approval policies, cadence, memory seed, action plan, client lifecycle, offer model, tracking model
signals.rationale: Complete manifest of what onboarding produces. Operator enters active mode with a fully configured operating system.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 8 business stages: Idea, Validation, Launch, Early Revenue, Growth, Scale, Enterprise, Portfolio/Institutional
signals.rationale: Stage taxonomy governs operational maturity assumptions for all generated artifacts.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 5 complexity levels: Solo Operator, Lean Team, Growing Team, Multi-Department, Multi-Entity
signals.rationale: Complexity taxonomy determines team structure generation depth, agent count, and governance sophistication.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EA Agent is the primary operator-facing intake node. Receives from operator, routes to Portfolio Advisor or CEO Agent. Never routes to department agents directly. NOT IMPLEMENTED in code.
signals.rationale: Critical gap. EA Agent is the keystone of the corrected routing chain. Must be built.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Portfolio Advisor Agent handles portfolio-level strategy, capital allocation, cross-entity intelligence. NOT IMPLEMENTED in code.
signals.rationale: Critical gap. Required for multi-entity portfolio management. No portfolio-level intelligence without it.

signals.summarized_source_claim: CEO Agent owns entity-level strategy, department coordination, delegation. IMPLEMENTED in projections/eos/agents/ceo.py. Contains instance-specific hardcoded values.
signals.rationale: Implemented but needs generalization. Instance-specific Initiate Arena references must be replaced with BIS runtime lookup.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 9 implemented department agents (sales, marketing, operations, finance, legal, customer_success, product, hr, engineering) with 62 total skills. 6 additional agents defined as professional gaps (admin, research, content, automation, investment_analyst, asset_manager, property_manager).
signals.rationale: 10 implemented (including CEO) plus 6 planned. Permission tiers enforced. Skills registered per agent.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EA routing decision logic: portfolio-scope requests go to Portfolio Advisor, entity-scope requests go to CEO Agent. Ambiguous requests trigger clarifying question.
signals.rationale: Routing rules are the decision logic for the communication chain. 8 conditions for Portfolio Advisor, 6 conditions for CEO.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 6-step delegation protocol: CEO receives task -> classifies by department -> checks permission tier -> delegates with context/constraints/deadline -> monitors completion -> reports to EA
signals.rationale: Delegation protocol defines how CEO distributes work to department agents with governance gates.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Escalation chain: department -> CEO -> EA -> operator. 8 escalation triggers including permission tier exceeded, ambiguity, cross-department dependency, risk threshold.
signals.rationale: Escalation protocol ensures problems flow upward with context and recommendations.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Chat box is one input surface among many. EA processes chat but results manifest across the entire UI. Chat is NOT the entire product.
signals.rationale: Prevents over-reliance on chat as the product. EA should proactively suggest moving to appropriate UI surfaces.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 6 event types logged: communication, task, decision, approval, workflow_action, memory_item. Full audit trail from operator input through execution and back.
signals.rationale: Structured event logging is the audit trail substrate. Required for governance, compliance, and debugging.

signals.summarized_source_claim: EOS is a business-in-a-box operating system and portfolio/entity/business/investment operating substrate
signals.rationale: Canonical product identity definition from operator correction.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 15 product-identity statements defining what EOS is: business architecture as software, company operating system, portfolio substrate, entity lifecycle manager, economic activity orchestrator, AI-native enterprise platform, etc.
signals.rationale: Comprehensive product identity. Each statement is a facet of the full product vision.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 10 anti-identity statements: not a CRM, not a simple dashboard, not a workflow tool, not a generic AI copilot, not a portfolio tracker, not a business admin panel, not a project management tool, not an accounting system, not a creator platform, not a marketplace
signals.rationale: Anti-identity prevents product drift into adjacent categories.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 9 target user segments: solo operators, founders, entrepreneurs, small teams, holding companies, family offices, investment operators, private equity operators, institutional operators
signals.rationale: Broadened from solo founders to full spectrum from solo to institutional.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 15 UMH-to-EOS capability mappings: signal processing -> business event processing, execution pipeline -> business task execution, governance -> business governance, etc.
signals.rationale: Defines how every UMH substrate capability projects into EOS business-specific capability.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 8 entity types: LLC, C-Corp, Holding Company, SPV, Real Estate Entity, Investment Entity, Operating Company, Asset Holding Entity
signals.rationale: Entity type taxonomy covers all common legal/operational vehicles for economic activity.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 19 business types: AI Automation Agency, Creative Agency, Marketing Agency, Consulting, Coaching/Info-Product, SaaS, E-Commerce, Local Service, Media/Content, Fashion/Apparel, Real Estate, Stock/Investment, Private Investment/Holding, Family Office, Productized Service, Marketplace, Community/Knowledge, Manufacturing, Enterprise
signals.rationale: Business type catalog with model, description, and example KPIs per type. Governs onboarding generation.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 13 hierarchy-level definitions with cardinality, key attributes, and provenance: Operator/User, Portfolio, Entity, Business/Company/Venture/Organization, Asset, Investment, Team, Agent, Role, Workflow, SOP, Tool, KPI
signals.rationale: Canonical definitions for every level of the 8-level hierarchy. Each with attributes and relationships.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 1 Frontend Foundations: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Two divergent implementations. Beast has 3x the code. BLOCKED on source strategy.
signals.rationale: Frontend stack is defined. Blocked on DEC-145-001 source strategy decision.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 2 APIs + Backend Logic: Express 4 + TypeScript. No API documentation, no OpenAPI spec, no request validation middleware, no API versioning. BLOCKED.
signals.rationale: API layer exists in Beast but lacks documentation and validation. Blocked on source convergence.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 3 Database + Storage: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM. No production database provisioned. Schema divergence between branches.
signals.rationale: Database target is defined. No production database exists. Schema needs alignment after source convergence.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 4 Auth + Permissions: Clerk target. GitHub main has legacy Passport.js. Beast has Clerk integrated but not validated end-to-end.
signals.rationale: Auth target is Clerk. Beast has partial implementation. End-to-end validation required.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 5 Hosting + Deployment: Fly.io target. No production deployment exists. No Dockerfile. No health check endpoint.
signals.rationale: Complete deployment gap. Fly.io is target but zero infrastructure exists.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layers 6-7: Cloud/Compute (Fly.io + Neon + Clerk managed services) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions). Both complete gaps with no infrastructure.
signals.rationale: Cloud compute and CI/CD are complete gaps. Defined as targets, nothing implemented.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 8 Security + RLS: No RLS configured. No security headers. No CSP. No security audit. EOS handles company/portfolio/financial data - RLS is mandatory.
signals.rationale: Security is a complete gap. RLS mandatory for multi-tenant financial data. HIGH risk.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layers 9-11: Rate limiting, caching/CDN, load balancing/scaling. All complete gaps. Low-medium risk for initial launch.
signals.rationale: Rate limiting, caching, and scaling are important but not blocking for initial single-user launch.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 12 Error Tracking + Logs: No structured logging, no error tracking, no PostHog, console.log only. HIGH risk.
signals.rationale: Error tracking is mandatory before production deployment. PostHog for product analytics.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Layer 13 Availability + Recovery: No backups, no rollback, no monitoring. RTO < 1 hour, RPO < 24 hours target.
signals.rationale: Recovery infrastructure is a complete gap. Neon provides automatic backups when provisioned.

signals.summarized_source_claim: GitHub main (202 files, Passport.js, stale since 2026-02-20) vs Beast feature/company-system (603 files, Clerk, active development). Beast is canonical candidate per DEC-145-001.
signals.rationale: Source strategy decision DEC-145-001 is the primary blocker for all EOS development. Beast promotion recommended.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 8 top gaps: Beast not merged (critical), legacy auth on main (high), department/role management missing (medium), workflow run view missing (medium), memory/knowledge missing (medium), no production deployment (medium), near-zero tests (high), no UMH integration boundary (medium)
signals.rationale: Gap inventory from convergence plan. Each gap has severity and work packet assignment.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 17 data concepts: Users, Companies, Departments, Roles, Workflows, WorkflowSteps, WorkflowRuns, Tasks, Documents, MemoryObjects, AIThreads, AIMessages, KnowledgeGraph nodes/edges, Skills, AgentConfigs, Metrics, UniversalBusinessPrimitives
signals.rationale: Data concepts map to the ontology definitions. Expanded in portfolio/entity ontology with corrected hierarchy.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 8 AI agent concepts: strategy agents, planning agents, execution agents, hierarchical orchestration, skill router with trust scoring, AI copilot (mentor+operator+chief of staff), confidence escalation, cost-aware model routing
signals.rationale: Agent concepts preserved and expanded in communication/delegation architecture with corrected routing chain.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 6 UMH integration assumptions: EOS is UMH projection, substrate provides identity/memory/KG/skills/workflows/AI-gateway/governance/observability, registers via abstract ports, strict layer separation, intelligence routing via model_router.py, cc_sdk fallback chain
signals.rationale: UMH integration assumptions are foundational architecture. Expanded in business democratization doctrine with 15 capability mappings.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Auth assumptions: current Clerk, target Clerk, end-state hybrid RBAC+ABAC+policy-based with org/resource/execution authority layers. OS Platform Standard v1 Firebase recommendation is STALE.
signals.rationale: Clerk is confirmed auth provider. Firebase recommendation is historical. End-state RBAC+ABAC is the governance target.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Database: Neon Postgres with RLS scoped by org_id, Drizzle ORM. Embedding dimension mismatch (384 vs 1536) unresolved.
signals.rationale: Database stack confirmed. Embedding dimension mismatch is an open question requiring operator decision.

signals.summarized_source_claim: MVP scope: AI-assisted company command center for one founder and one business. 5 releases: R1 Core Shell, R2 Org+Tasks, R3 Workflows, R4 AI Copilot, R5 Docs+Memory. 10 explicit exclusions.
signals.rationale: MVP definition with release sequence and explicit exclusions. Note: operator correction broadens from one business to one portfolio with multiple entities.

signals.summarized_source_claim: PRD quality scores: completeness 8, specificity 6, actionability 5. Strengths: comprehensive WHAT, novel taxonomy, well-scoped MVP. Weaknesses: no wireframes, no API contracts, no UI specs, aspirational vision mixed with audits.
signals.rationale: Self-assessment of PRD quality. Weaknesses are being addressed by Phase 14.6B artifacts (UI canon, communication arch, ontology, etc.).

signals.summarized_source_claim: GitHub main: 202 files, Replit Agent authored, last commit 2026-02-20. Passport.js + Firebase auth. Basic React/Vite/TypeScript/shadcn/Tailwind. 15 DB tables. Minimal routes.
signals.rationale: GitHub main is stale baseline. Beast is canonical candidate. Main preserved as historical reference only.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Beast feature/company-system: 603 files, Clerk auth, company system, portfolio management, 14 route modules, 32 pages, expanded schema. Active development.
signals.rationale: Beast is canonical candidate (DEC-145-001). 3x more code than main. Clerk auth aligned with target.

signals.summarized_source_claim: UMH EOS Projection: 10 department agents, 3 views, 3 workflows, entities.py, full UMH integration. 5699 lines. DepartmentAgent base class with permission tier enforcement.
signals.rationale: UMH projection is the agent-layer truth. Defines how EOS agents interface with UMH substrate.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should EOS enforce dark mode only or ship both dark and light from day one?
signals.rationale: Design decision. Recommendation: ship both, default to dark.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should Beast design-tokens.ts values be preserved or replaced with finance-grade direction?
signals.rationale: Design token reconciliation. Recommendation: audit and update divergent values.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should EOS adopt Inter or stay with system fonts?
signals.rationale: Typography decision. Recommendation: Inter for tabular numerals and professional feel.

signals.summarized_source_claim: What level of information density? Bloomberg-level vs Stripe-level?
signals.rationale: Density decision. Recommendation: Stripe-level default with operator option to increase.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should Activity/Event Feed live as tab in Right Rail or separate panel?
signals.rationale: Layout decision. Recommendation: tab in Right Rail to avoid adding more shell chrome.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should EA Agent be DepartmentAgent subclass or distinct agent type?
signals.rationale: Architecture decision for EA implementation. EA has fundamentally different role from department agents.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should operators be able to bypass EA and communicate directly with CEO or department agents?
signals.rationale: Power-user direct access vs. enforced routing chain. Could be configurable permission.

signals.summarized_source_claim: How should routing chain handle multi-portfolio operators?
signals.rationale: Multi-portfolio adds another routing layer. Current model assumes one portfolio context.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should department agents be instantiated per-entity or shared across entities?
signals.rationale: Per-entity instances enable entity-specific memory. Shared instances are lighter but risk context bleeding.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should onboarding support creating multiple entities in a single flow?
signals.rationale: Default assumption: single entity per flow, add more from active workspace.

signals.summarized_source_claim: What is the minimum viable onboarding? Can operator skip all generation?
signals.rationale: Default assumption: yes, bare portfolio + entity should be possible.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should onboarding persist state for resume or require single-session completion?
signals.rationale: Default assumption: persisted state, operator can resume at any point.

signals.summarized_source_claim: What import formats supported for Import Existing Operation path?
signals.rationale: Default assumption: CSV and JSON for v1. Notion, QuickBooks, Xero for future.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Should AI generation happen sequentially or in a single batch?
signals.rationale: Default assumption: sequential with real-time display for engagement.

signals.summarized_source_claim: Beast has company creation flow but not portfolio-first flow. Portfolio layer must be added above company.
signals.rationale: HIGH severity blocking debt. Beast code assumes company-first, corrected hierarchy requires portfolio-first.

signals.summarized_source_claim: AI generation engine for onboarding steps 8-19 does not exist. Each step needs entity-type-aware, stage-aware, complexity-aware generation logic.
signals.rationale: HIGH severity blocking debt. No generation engine exists. Must be built from scratch.

signals.summarized_source_claim: No inter-agent routing infrastructure. Current agents are standalone classes with no message passing, delegation protocol, or routing logic.
signals.rationale: Critical gap. Routing chain is architecturally defined but not mechanically implemented.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 5 UI implementation debts: no design system documentation, no Storybook, no dark mode verified, no accessibility audit, no keyboard shortcuts.
signals.rationale: UI infrastructure gaps. Accessibility audit is HIGH severity. Others are MEDIUM-LOW.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 5 MVP releases: R1 Core Shell (auth, company, settings), R2 Org+Tasks, R3 Workflows, R4 AI Copilot, R5 Docs+Memory
signals.rationale: Release sequence defines the build order. Note: R1 needs correction from company to portfolio+entity per operator hierarchy correction.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 10 explicit MVP exclusions: portfolio multi-company orchestration, full autonomous agents, multi-agent collaboration, advanced market intelligence, human intelligence graph, local/offline AI, multi-region, full shared runtime, enterprise permissions, skill marketplace
signals.rationale: Explicit exclusions define the MVP boundary. Note: operator correction adds portfolio management to MVP scope, partially contradicting exclusion #1.

signals.summarized_source_claim: 12 acceptance criteria: founder can create workspace, define org structure, create/AI-generate workflows, run workflows with AI, manage tasks, ask AI for help, return to retained context, plus 5 end-state criteria
signals.rationale: Acceptance criteria define what success looks like. MVP criteria (7) and end-state criteria (5) preserved separately.
